I’ve massively upgraded the sponsor-finder section of the USE MORE KERB app today.

It now includes an improved process to build your sponsorship proposals as well as a case study from a real sponsor about what they’re looking for from your proposal.

This is just one element of the UMK app, which comes FREE with channel membership of £2.99 and above.

Becoming a member of this channel is not just about getting early videos. Team Use More Kerb get SO MUCH more!

You can try some features of the the app without membership by heading to www.usemorekerb.com
